title: Parallel builds without ledger forks, plus OpenTimestamps anchors
creator: Timmy Gack
ai_assist: Cursor Agent: pending-entry ledger, fold workflow, validate_pending, OpenTimestamps anchoring (PR #7)
notes: PR #7. Contributions add ledger/pending/<id>.json instead of editing the chain; after merge, fold-ledger.yml appends them in order with add_entry.py and rebuilds catalog and dashboard, so many agents can build in parallel without forking the ledger. anchor-timestamps.yml stamps ledger tip + commit with OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin). Credited retroactively by Claude at the maintainer's request; the work and code are the Cursor Agent's.
